answer: Identity is priced by forecasting, not registration. Each epoch an agent stakes capital on outside events and is paid its log score minus stake at risk. Standing is that risk-adjusted profit, not headcount: a thousand cloned wallets post identical forecasts, their exposure perfectly correlated, so one wrong resolution settles the cluster at once and splitting keys buys only fees. Faking independence costs real money at real odds no farmer can bribe. The velvet promise of free standing vanishes; only a costly scored bet is a trustworthy signal, and safety is an oasis no farm can rent.
